values.note: 2026: campsites $35 a day plus tax; stays of 30+ days the same rate without tax; tent sites $25; camper cabins $80.

fees.source: 2026 policy PDF ('Games Lake County Park Daily Fees $35.00 plus tax Camper Cabin $80.00 Tent Sites $25.00 30 plus days sites same prices as daily but without tax'; '(30 days or longer stays are not subject to sales tax)'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Online reservations only (ResNexus), paid by card at booking. From Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day a reservation must be for 7 or more continuous days; before Memorial Day weekend and after Labor Day sites may be rented by the day. Seasonal campers register first; 2026 registration opened January 20.

booking.source: 2026 policy PDF ('Reservations must be for 7 or more continuous days, except for designated tenting camp sites and Pre-Memorial Day Weekend and Post Labor Day, campsites maybe rented by the day.'; 'Effective January 20th, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ONLY On-Line camping reservations will be taken on a first come, first serve basis.'; 'Seasonal Campers get the first seven days to register.'; 'Payments accepted by CREDIT CARD ONLY.') + county page (Games Lake 'Sites' link to ResNexus), read 2026-11-11

note: Kandiyohi County park on the east shore of Games Lake (Norway chain of lakes), north of Willmar; wooded campground behind the park's beach, store and parking. Generators are not allowed where electricity is provided. --Claude
